ordered_branches.explanation: Loads shipment-header-view values by internal shipment number; NULL trailing status deletes request immediately. Iterates alert criteria joined by name/type. Maps shipment fields into nvarchar50. Privately verified TOTAL_LINES, TOTAL_VALUE and TOTAL_WEIGHT receive CAST AS numeric comparisons (default zero scale), so fractional precision is not preserved and malformed criteria can error. All other fields, including priority/internal order number, compare UPPER text. Operators use inverse rejection tests; unknown operator defaults to equality. Empty criteria or NULL comparison results can leave the request intact. First failure deletes by request ID without warehouse/context relationship guard.
